pine needle javelin.desc: a dead brown pine needle. A bit bulky to wield, and too light to do proper damage.

greenwood bow.desc: a greenwood bow with raw silk bowstring. Fires arrows made of sapped wood splinters.

slingshot.desc: a wooden slingshot that uses the elasticity of spider silk to shoot sharp rocks.

splinter spear.desc: a wooden splinter hardened with plant sap.

chitin spiked mace.desc: a chitin spiked mace that somewhat preserves the previous shape of an ant leg.

ant leg.desc: a limb broken off from a dead ant. It is pretty strong and could be used to swing around.

silk robe.desc: a silk robe made from a combination of spiderweb and some kind of fur. It allows you to approach enemies without them noticing. Grants you the 'Sneak' skill.

silk pants.desc: a silk pants made from a combination of spiderweb and some kind of fur. Very common.

grass robe.desc: a grass robe made from woven grass fibers. Provides very little warmth.

homebound scroll.desc: a scroll of teleportation bound to Ant Hill. Use to instantly teleport there.

human corpse.desc: a human corpse. Could be edible, I guess.

ant meat.desc: an ant meat. It has become the main source of protein for humans.

cooked ant meat.desc: a cooked ant meat. Comes with a chitin plate, fully ready to serve. Doesn't really smell like anything.

blood drop.desc: a drop of blood. It sticks to you, making it convenient to carry around. Has an unpleasant taste. Very fulfilling.
